requirements.gpt2-large-polar-express-best-all-lr: Figure 1 shows that muon-PolarExp achieves a strictly lower final validation loss than both muon-Jordan and muon-You on GPT-2-Large across all learning rates tested, with the advantage described in Section 4.2 as 'remarkably consistent across all learning rates and epochs'.
requirements.gpt2-small-polar-express-best-all-lr: Figure 4 shows that muon-PolarExp achieves a strictly lower final validation loss than both muon-Jordan and muon-You on GPT-2-Small across all learning rates tested, consistent with Section 4.2's statement that the advantage is consistent across all learning rates.
requirements.weight-decay-polar-express-still-best: Figure 12 shows that muon-PolarExp achieves a strictly lower final validation loss than both muon-Jordan and muon-You on both GPT-2-Small and GPT-2-Large across all learning rates tested when weight decay of 0.1 is used, consistent with Section 4.3's statement that 'the results are quite similar to Figures 1 and 4. We again find that muon-PolarExp outperforms the other methods'.
